report_name: US Treasury Forms Task Force to Guard Finance Sector from Quantum Threats

threat_actors.name: Unspecified Quantum Adversaries
threat_actors.description: A general class of future or current adversaries who possess or will possess quantum computing capabilities to break current encryption, or who are currently engaging in 'harvest now, decrypt later' data collection in anticipation of such capabilities.
threat_actors.goals: To decrypt sensitive, currently-encrypted data in the future by leveraging quantum computing capabilities.

attack_patterns.name: Data Staged
attack_patterns.description: Adversaries are collecting and staging encrypted financial data with the intent of decrypting it in the future once quantum computers are available. This is referred to as the 'harvest now, decrypt later' threat.

vulnerabilities.name: Vulnerability of Public-Key Cryptography to Quantum Computing
vulnerabilities.description: Current public-key cryptography standards are vulnerable to being broken by a sufficiently powerful quantum computer. This poses a threat to the security of digital financial transactions, data storage, and communications.

identities.name: U.S. Department of the Treasury
identities.description: Announced the formation of the Quantum-Readiness Task Force to prepare the U.S. financial system for threats posed by quantum computing.

identities.name: G7 Cyber Expert Group
identities.description: Released a roadmap with a target of 2035 for completing the financial sector's transition to post-quantum cryptography (PQC).

identities.name: Financial institutions
identities.description: A class of organizations, including banks, credit unions, and investment firms, that will be impacted by the transition to post-quantum cryptography.

identities.name: Market infrastructure operators
identities.description: A class of organizations, including stock exchanges and clearing houses, that will be impacted by the transition to post-quantum cryptography.

identities.name: Technology providers
identities.description: A class of organizations, including software vendors, that supply the financial sector and will need to adopt post-quantum cryptography.

identities.name: Cloud service providers
identities.description: A class of organizations that provide cloud services to the financial sector and will need to adopt post-quantum cryptography.

relationships.target_name: Vulnerability of Public-Key Cryptography to Quantum Computing
